circumstance: A wet dispersal and a dependable engineering section. Sunday Punch needs attention before the heavier requests.

aircraft.name: Lucky Lady
history: Accepted by the station engineering officer.

aircraft.name: Sunday Punch
history: Accepted by the station engineering officer.

aircraft.name: Skylark
history: Accepted by the station engineering officer.

aircraft.name: Old Sinner
history: Accepted by the station engineering officer.

assignments.title: The coastal yards
assignments.objective: Cut the railway sidings serving the coast.
assignments.why: A short first assignment. Disrupting these supplies will give the group room to settle in.

assignments.title: Fighters on the ground
assignments.objective: Strike the dispersal areas at a coastal fighter field.
assignments.why: Aircraft destroyed here cannot meet tomorrow’s bomber stream.

assignments.title: The canal crossing
assignments.objective: Interrupt freight at the canal marshalling yard.
assignments.why: HQ needs a full section. The workshops ahead are a harder assignment.

assignments.title: Engine works
assignments.objective: Put the engine assembly halls out of operation.
assignments.why: This is the first deep penetration. Experienced crews will earn their keep.

assignments.title: A narrow window
assignments.objective: Strike a repair depot while rolling stock is concentrated.
assignments.why: A good result releases scarce transport for our own station.

assignments.title: Beyond the estuary
assignments.objective: Hit the railway approaches beyond the estuary.
assignments.why: Traffic has shifted inland. Every effective aircraft slows that movement.

assignments.title: The northern airfield
assignments.objective: Crater the fighter field’s service and dispersal areas.
assignments.why: The group is gathering for a larger effort. Reduce the opposition now.

assignments.title: The long haul
assignments.objective: Attack the inland aircraft component works.
assignments.why: HQ requests the whole flight. A smaller contribution is accepted, but leaves more work to other stations.

assignments.title: A shorter run
assignments.objective: Cut the coastal supply line a second time.
assignments.why: A limited assignment offers a chance to rotate tired crews.

assignments.title: Closing the net
assignments.objective: Attack a fighter repair and storage depot.
assignments.why: Successful bombing will ease interception on the next assignment.

assignments.title: The western junction
assignments.objective: Block the rail junction feeding the inland factories.
assignments.why: Three assignments will remain after this one. Preserve enough strength to finish.

assignments.title: The last push · I
assignments.why: The final three assignments are fixed. Today’s result can protect the last deep raid.

assignments.title: The last push · II
assignments.why: The tour’s heaviest remaining objective. Tomorrow asks for only two aircraft.

assignments.title: Bring them home
assignments.objective: Make one final strike against the coastal railway.
assignments.why: Relief crews arrive after this assignment. Make the contribution you can sustain.

messages: The package is airborne. Standing orders are in force.

report.title: The coastal yards
report.summary: 2 effective strikes from 2 dispatched. HQ requested 2.

results.note: An effective strike; aircraft and crew home without incident.
An effective strike; aircraft and crew home without incident.

notes: Sunday Punch was allocated proper repair.

jobs.text: Group reports the formation approaching the objective. A full accounting will follow at return.
